## 問題
2025 年 3 月新註冊的客戶有幾位？

## 回答 A
最終答案: 150
採用的定義與依據: 以 customers.signup_date（YYYY-MM-DD 純日期文字，無需時區換算；全表無空值）篩選 2025-03-01 至 2025-03-31，共 150 筆，皆為不重複 customer_id。新註冊客戶定義採用客戶的註冊日期。
SQL 1: ["SELECT signup_date, typeof(signup_date) AS t, length(signup_date) AS len FROM customers ORDER BY random() LIMIT 10", "SELECT MIN(signup_date) AS min_d, MAX(signup_date) AS max_d, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date IS NULL OR signup_date = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blank_cnt FROM customers"]

SQL 2: SELECT COUNT(*) AS signup_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customers FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-03-01' AND signup_date < '2025-04-01'
  結果: {'columns': ['signup_cnt', 'distinct_customers'], 'rows': [[150, 150]], 'truncated': False}

## 回答 B
最終答案: 150
採用的定義與依據: 語意層無對應的「新註冊客戶」定義，因此以 customers 資料表的 signup_date 欄位判定註冊日期。統計 signup_date 落在 2025-03-01 至 2025-03-31 的客戶數，customer_id 為主鍵，結果為 150 位。
SQL 1: SELECT substr(signup_date,1,7) AS ym, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(signup_date) AS min_d, MAX(signup_date) AS max_d FROM customers GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym

raw: {"winner": "A", "reason": "兩者答案同為 150 且定義一致，但 A 先檢查了 signup_date 的格式與空值，再用明確的日期區間查詢並以 COUNT DISTINCT 驗證，直接得出 150；B 只有按月分組的查詢，且結果片段被截斷，看不到 2025-03 的數值，可驗證性較弱。", "critical_error": false}
